title: 48V Water Gun Spray Cleaner Car Washer  6 In 1 Nozzle, Handheld High Pressure Washer For Car Floor Garden Cleaning And Watering
body_html:
Product Description

48V High-Pressure Water Gun Cleaner, 6-in-1 Nozzle, Handheld High-Pressure Cleaner, suitable for car/floor/garden cleaning and watering

Packaging: Boxed

Packaging Dimensions: Cardboard box: 24 * 22 * 12cm; Plastic box: 34.5 * 11 * 28cm

Product Dimensions: 43 * 24cm

Product Material: ABS + Hardware

Accessories List: Barrel*1 + Nozzle*1 + 5m Water Hose*1 + Water Hose Connector*1 + Filter*1 + Makita Battery*1 + Charger*1 + Body*1

Drive Method: Lithium Battery Wireless Drive

Speed: 30000 RPM

Maximum Flow Rate: 3.7L/min

Spray Stroke: 6-10m

Water Hose Length: 4-5m

Charger Standard: EU

Car Wash Equipment Type: Home Car Wash Machine

Water Source Type: Suitable for Self-priming Faucets

Applications: Car washing, watering flowers, watering vegetables, spraying, garden cleaning, etc.

Features:

1. Made with special waterproof materials, waterproof and dustproof, with electrical protection functions for enhanced safety.

2. Two water inlet methods: self-priming and faucet-type, making water intake more convenient.

3. Equipped with temperature protection function, automatically cutting off power in case of overheating or overload to eliminate safety hazards.

4. 5. Large-capacity water tank for smooth water intake

6. Multiple high-quality expansion accessories for easier and more thorough cleaning

7. Multi-functional high-pressure washer, ideal for car washing, garden watering, agricultural irrigation, and daily cleaning

8. Easy installation; all interface plugs can be quickly installed.
